data.name: Bakir
data.long_meaning: The name Bakir is of Arabic origin and translates to 'sword'. This name is derived from the Arabic word 'bakara', meaning 'to slice or to cleave'. In Islamic history, Bakr ibn Abdullah was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and was known for his bravery and loyalty.

Bakr ibn Abdullah, also known as 'Bakr Al-Harithi', was a brave warrior and leader who played a vital role in the early Islamic wars and conquests. He was one of the ten companions who were given the title 'As-Sabab Al-Muttahajj domin' (The Ten Promised Paradise) in the Hadith. Bakr's name reflects the martial aspects of early Islamic society and serves as a reminder of the heroism and courage that defined this period.
